objective: Validate 16 bounded synthetic episode trajectories over seeds 1 through 16 using a 0.25 per-tick test-only hazard, 32-tick inclusive horizon and 32-executed-event bound; expose only core ObservedPolicyState (observed tick, versioned urgency, elapsed wait) to DecisionPolicy. No patient/service state or future event is added to that policy input, and no clinical rate or prediction claim is introduced.
interface_contract: B1 plan/test matrix; CC-04 and CC-08 in composition-contracts; core ObservedPolicyState and DecisionPolicy API; careops-birthing runtime at packet base.
steps: Add a domain-facing helper that constructs core ObservedPolicyState from the episode current tick plus supplied VersionedUrgencyAssessment and elapsed-wait value. Reject an assessment timestamp later than the observation tick. The core policy input contains only observed tick, assessment, and elapsed wait; patient/service state and queued future events are not passed to this API.

Add negative controls with identical policy inputs but different patient/service states and pending future-event queues; DecisionPolicy must receive identical values and produce identical decisions. Reject a future-dated assessment and assert the complete VersionedUrgencyAssessment value, including jurisdiction, scheme/version, category, assessment tick, effective date, source authority, citation and optional source hash, is preserved.

Add deterministic synthetic bounded-trajectory controls for exactly seeds 1..=16, using a test-only hazard rate 0.25 per simulation tick, inclusive horizon 32 and maximum 32 executed events. Assert monotone event ticks, no post-horizon event executes, every unfinished run records censor tick 32, and no run exceeds the event bound. Repeat each seed and require identical trace and observation.
Use test-only synthetic hazards and target mappings only; retain no clinical parameter/profile change and no prediction claim.
Run focused B1.3 and B1.2 runtime tests, core policy/pathway compatibility tests, and Rust format check. Record exact seeds, horizon, event bound, toolchain and source/fixture hashes.
Obtain reviewer-agent review of the integrated commit, fix all findings, then coordinator records acceptance and updates the phase DAG.

verification.oracle: Bounded trajectory and observation-only negative controls execute and pass alongside B1.2 regression tests.
Existing ObservedPolicyState/DecisionPolicy versioning and observed-only contract remain compatible.

acceptance: Policy input contains only the episode observation tick, supplied versioned urgency assessment and elapsed wait; patient/service values and future queued event content are structurally absent. Different patient/service states or pending future queues with equal inputs produce equal policy decisions.

Future-dated assessment is rejected; a valid assessment preserves every VersionedUrgencyAssessment field, including jurisdiction, scheme/version, category, assessment tick, effective date, authority, citation and optional source hash.

For seeds 1..=16, a synthetic per-tick hazard 0.25, horizon 32 and event bound 32, each same-seed run replays identically, event ticks are monotone, no post-horizon event executes, and unfinished episodes are censored at tick 32.
All parameters are synthetic test controls; no clinical prediction, calibration, site-policy or operational acceptance is claimed.
stop_conditions: Core observed-policy contract cannot be composed without inventing policy
A trajectory bound needs unsourced clinical parameter values
Test nondeterminism appears across repeated same-seed execution
